policies.coder_attribution: CIX/count-range pairs are matched-information SIZE controls only. Count-range computes exact rank before arithmetic sequence coding, so their timings are not a fair CIX speed comparison. Accounting names actual selected raw/runs/CIX/deflate coders.
policies.matched_control: same source identity, profile, effective backend and resource limits; CPU ordinal is excluded
policies.old_references: not combined with current results; hardware/configuration provenance must remain separate
policies.physical: primary repetition archive only after all three retained archives rehash

route_semantics.ppm_mixture: fixed context/model comparison, not backend attribution
route_semantics.runs: route-cost comparison versus unchanged original, not a forced-hybrid claim

policies.timing: median of three full leaf-process timings; startup, I/O, profiling and discarded trials included
